seo.description_paragraph: Barbabas is a Greek name with deep roots in both Greek and Hebrew cultures. Derived from the Greek name Βαρβασ (Barbas), meaning 'son of the exalted one', Barbabas shares its origins with the Hebrew name Barabbas, which translates to 'son of the father'. This powerful name has historical significance in Christianity, as it was the name of a man mentioned in the New Testament who was released from prison instead of Jesus at the request of the crowd.
